name: Abigail
summary: The wise and beautiful wife of Nabal, whose quick gifts and words kept David from taking revenge on her husband. After Nabal died, she became the wife of David.

key_moments.title: Hurrying to Meet David
key_moments.description: When she heard Nabal had insulted David, Abigail loaded donkeys with bread, wine, meat and fruit and rode to meet him. She bowed before David and begged him not to shed blood, and he blessed her for her advice.

key_moments.title: Becoming David's Wife
key_moments.description: Ten days after Abigail told Nabal what she had done, the LORD struck him and he died. David sent for Abigail, and she became his wife.

key_moments.title: Captured and Rescued
key_moments.description: Amalekites burned Ziklag and carried off the women, among them Abigail. David went after them and rescued his two wives.
